frame_protocol.declaration_timing: Written before the discovery searches for this frame. Existing v0.4 register and source_stream_protocol_v07.json were read first.
frame_protocol.selection: Purposeful English-language convenience development sample. frame_protocol.fallback_rule: If a candidate has no verified pair in this bounded pass, log its exclusion and report a shortfall; no replacement chosen for model difficulty.
frame_protocol.search_terms: Organization name plus leadership CEO announcement transition, or named plan plus original announcement update delay reversal cancellation extension. Use official publisher domains; follow their official links when needed.
frame_protocol.verification: Open each selected primary URL through web retrieval. Record title, visible reported publication date only when verified, source order evidence and unresolved availability/version gaps. Search-result-only records are not verified pairs.
frame_protocol.explicit_corrections: No quota. Label a separate challenge slice only if an explicit notice identifies erroneous prior content. A changed plan or retrospective restatement is not a factual correction.
frame_protocol.freeze: Freeze final metadata before any future source capture, candidate extraction, reference questions or decoder run for this frame.
frame_protocol.claim_limit: Convenience development metadata only; no prevalence, random representativeness, untouched evaluation, historical first-availability, or completed-history claim.
